# Overview

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "krm",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",

  )
)
```

```{r krm_overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_overview(
  family = "krm",
  summary = paste(
    "The Kirchhoff-ray mode model (`KRM`) calculates composite monostatic",
    "backscatter from a fish body and an explicitly represented gas-filled",
    "swimbladder."
  ),
  core_idea = paste(
    "Treat the segmented flesh body with a Kirchhoff-style approximation, use",
    "an acoustic-size-dependent mode or ray description for the swimbladder,",
    "and combine the component amplitudes coherently",
    "[@Clay_1991; @Clay_1994]."
  ),
  best_for = c(
    "Gas-bearing fish with separate body and swimbladder outlines",
    "Frequency and orientation studies where the internal gas component dominates or interferes with the body return",
    "Comparison of supported KRM material and embedding variants"
  ),
  supports = c(
    "`SBF` objects with body and swimbladder shapes, placement, and orientation",
    "Separate body and bladder material descriptions",
    "Stored body, swimbladder, and coherently combined outputs"
  ),
  assumptions = c(
    "Segment-wise body and simplified swimbladder approximations",
    "The selected KRM variant matches the intended material interpretation",
    "Coherent first-order component combination",
    "No fully coupled body-swimbladder boundary solve or repeated rescattering"
  ),
  reading = c(
    "[Implementation](krm-implementation.html): building fish objects, variants, component output, and comparisons",
    "[Theory](krm-theory.html): body term, swimbladder branches, and coherent sum"
  )
)
```
